description: Download a file or directory (crash dumps, replays, logs) from a session's container. The server returns an uncompressed tar archive, saved to a new private temp directory; the local path is returned.

path.description: Absolute path inside the container to export, e.g. /app/logs or /tmp/crash.dmp

session.description: Session ID to download artifacts from

name: gameye_get_artifacts
title: Download session artifacts
